exposure: Receipt of neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) care in a horizontally integrated multihospital health system
outcome: Length of stay among surviving infants
cohort: The study included 38,501 very preterm infants (gestational age 24-29 weeks) who received NICU care in 224 US multihospital health systems between January 1, 2021, and December 31, 2022.
finding: The study revealed a 2-percentage point difference in mortality and a 12-day difference in mean length of stay for very preterm infants between the highest and lowest performing health systems.
followup_time: up to 90 days (length of stay for surviving infants)
